brand.name: CodeCraft Academy
brand.description: A fictional online coding school used to demonstrate BrandGuard. All rules, facts and posts are made up for the demo.
brand.voice: Confident, warm and clear. We sound like a helpful senior, never a salesperson.

rules.title: Confident and warm, never boastful
rules.text: Write like a helpful senior. Avoid hype words such as 'insane', 'mind-blowing' or 'crazy'.
rules.good: Learn to build real projects with mentors who answer your questions.
rules.bad: This insane bootcamp will blow your mind!

rules.title: No slang or text-speak in official posts
rules.text: Official posts use full words. No text-speak.
rules.good: You are going to love this.

rules.title: No pressure tactics or all-caps urgency
rules.text: Give real dates instead of pressure. No 'last chance', 'hurry' or rows of exclamation marks.

rules.title: Every number must match an approved fact
rules.text: Numbers about students, ratings, discounts, partners or placements must match an approved fact that has not expired.

rules.title: Superlatives need an approved source
rules.text: Words like '#1', 'best', 'biggest', 'leading' or 'top' need an approved fact that proves them. We have none, so we do not use them.

rules.title: No guarantees about outcomes
rules.text: Never promise jobs, salaries or results. We offer placement support, not guarantees.
rules.good: Includes placement support and mock interviews.

rules.title: One clear call to action
rules.text: Every promotional post ends with exactly one clear call to action that matches the creator's intent.

rules.title: Plain language: keep sentences under 25 words
rules.text: Long sentences are hard to read, especially on phones and for non-native readers.
rules.bad: A 40-word sentence that keeps going with many clauses and ideas.

rules.title: Descriptive link text
rules.text: Do not write 'click here'. Say where the link goes.
rules.good: See the full schedule on our website.

rules.title: Avoid ALL-CAPS words
rules.text: All-caps words are read letter by letter by some screen readers and feel like shouting.

glossary.note: Brand name: one word, capital C twice.
Programme name is two words, 'Bootcamp' is one word.
Use 'sign up' (verb) in calls to action.

facts.statement: 38,000 students have enrolled in CodeCraft Academy courses.
The Winter Bootcamp discount is 70% until 30 Nov 2026.
Learners rate CodeCraft Academy 4.6 out of 5.
The Winter Bootcamp runs for 8 weeks.
CodeCraft Academy had 95 hiring partners (old figure).
Over 300 hours of mentor support were given last month.

samples.title: Instagram: Winter Bootcamp launch
samples.content: Join India's #1 coding platform! Over 50,000 students already learn with Codecraft Academy. Get 70% off the winter boot camp. LAST CHANCE!!! Signup today.

samples.title: Email: placement programme

intent.purpose: Invite learners to the placement programme

samples.content: Hi there, our placement programme is gonna change your life. We guarantee 100% placement with our 150 hiring partners, so u r basically hired already. Click here to register before seats run out!

samples.title: Ad: weekend workshop

intent.purpose: Fill seats in the weekend web development workshop

samples.content: Our mentors will help you build your first website in one weekend. Learners rate us 4.6 out of 5. Book a seat on our website.

samples.title: LinkedIn: partner update
samples.content: We now work with 95 hiring partners across India, and our world-class tutors have given more than 300 hours of mentor support last month, which is a number that we are really proud of because it shows how much our team cares about every single one of our customers and their success. Apply now.
